name: Spanking
overview: Scripture affirms the importance of parental discipline as an expression of love and wisdom, emphasizing that sparing the rod is tantamount to hating one's child, while timely chastening promotes righteousness and hope (Proverbs 13:24; 19:18). The instruction to train children in the right way ensures lasting obedience and moral integrity (Proverbs 22:6), and even physical discipline serves a purifying purpose to correct inner faults (Proverbs 20:30). This biblical guidance underscores the responsibility of parents to lovingly but firmly guide their children, as exemplified in the call to address stubbornness and rebellion with appropriate correction (Deuteronomy 21:18; Proverbs 13:1).
